question: Could you tell me the number of orders, average payment per order and customer lifespan in weeks of the 3 custumers with the highest average payment per order, where the lifespan is calculated by subtracting the earliest purchase date from the latest purchase date in days, dividing by seven, and if the result is less than seven days, setting it to 1.0?
sql:
WITH customer_payments AS (
    SELECT 
        o.customer_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS num_orders,
        SUM(op.payment_value) AS total_payment,
        SUM(op.payment_value) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS avg_payment_per_order
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_payments op ON o.order_id = op.order_id
    GROUP BY o.customer_id
),
customer_lifespan AS (
    SELECT 
        o.customer_id,
        (CAST(DATE_DIFF('day', CAST(MIN(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(MAX(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS TIMESTAMP)) AS DOUBLE) / 7.0) AS lifespan_weeks_raw
    FROM orders o
    GROUP BY o.customer_id
)
SELECT 
    cp.customer_id,
    cp.num_orders,
    ROUND(cp.avg_payment_per_order, 2) AS avg_payment_per_order,
    CASE 
        WHEN cl.lifespan_weeks_raw < 7.0 THEN 1.0
        ELSE cl.lifespan_weeks_raw
    END AS lifespan_weeks
FROM customer_payments cp
JOIN customer_lifespan cl ON cp.customer_id = cl.customer_id
ORDER BY cp.avg_payment_per_order DESC
LIMIT 3
